home.title: Ferrouswheel | Custom Metal Gifts in Bangalore — Nameplates, Keychains, Medal Hangers
home.description: Ferrouswheel makes custom metal gifts in Bangalore. Nameplates, keychains, bookmarks, medal hangers, clocks and more, cut in steel, brass or copper. We ship across India. Order on WhatsApp.

categories.title: Custom Metal Bookmarks with Your Name | Ferrouswheel Bangalore
categories.description: Metal bookmarks with your name on them, shaped like a cricket bat, a football, a violin or anything you like. Made in Bangalore, shipped across India. Great as return gifts.
intro: Paper bookmarks get lost. These don't. We cut each one from steel, brass or copper, shape it around something the reader loves, and add their name.
They're light, they survive school bags, and they make really good return gifts. Schools order them for prize days too.

categories.title: Custom Metal Keychains with Name, Car or Bike | Ferrouswheel
categories.description: Custom metal keychains made in Bangalore. Your car, your bike, your sport or just your name, cut in steel, brass or copper. We ship across India. Order on WhatsApp.
intro: No one likes boring keys. Tell us what you're into, like your car, your bike, your sport or your gym, and we'll cut it in metal with your name on it.
We send you the design on WhatsApp first, and only cut once you're happy. Need a set for your team or office? We do those too.

categories.title: Custom Metal Name Plates for Home and Desk | Ferrouswheel Bangalore
categories.description: Metal nameplates for your door, your kid's room or your desk, made in Bangalore. Add a tennis player, a car, a sneaker, whatever suits you. We ship across India.
intro: A name on its own is a bit plain. We add something that's actually you, like a tennis player, a car, a pair of sneakers or a guitar, and cut the whole thing in metal.
They work on front doors, kids' rooms and desks. Tell us where it's going and we'll get the size right.

categories.title: Custom Medal Hangers with Your Name and Sport | Ferrouswheel Bangalore
categories.description: Metal medal hangers with your name and your sport, made in Bangalore. For runners, cricketers, swimmers and school athletes. Bulk orders for schools and clubs.
intro: If your medals are sitting in a drawer, this is for you. We make medal hangers with your sport and your name cut in, strong enough to hold a big collection.
Runners, cricketers, swimmers and young athletes love them. Schools and clubs also order them for whole teams before Sports Day.

categories.title: Custom Metal Name Necklaces and Pendants | Ferrouswheel Bangalore
categories.description: Custom metal necklaces with a name, initials or an inside joke, made in Bangalore in steel, brass or copper. A gift nobody else will have. We ship across India.
intro: A name, an initial, a hobby or an inside joke only the two of you get. Tell us the idea and we'll turn it into a necklace.
Good for birthdays, best friends and anniversaries, or anyone who's hard to shop for.

categories.title: Custom Metal Wall Clocks for Sports and Hobby Fans | Ferrouswheel
categories.description: Metal wall clocks where your sport or hobby takes the place of the numbers. Football, cricket, cars, music and more. Made in Bangalore, shipped across India.
intro: On these clocks, your favourite sport or hobby takes the place of the numbers. So the wall tells people something about you, not just the time.
They look great in a bedroom, a games room or an office, and they make a gift that gets noticed every day.

categories.title: Handmade Metal Models of Bikes and Cars | Ferrouswheel Bangalore
categories.description: Handmade metal models and desk stands of bikes and cars, made in our Bangalore workshop. Send us photos of your ride and we'll build it.
intro: We make metal models of bikes, cars and anything else with wheels, including desk stands of your own ride.
Ferrouswheel started with a go-kart Yousuf built himself, so these are the pieces we enjoy most. Send us a few photos of your machine and we'll take it from there.

categories.title: Metal Wall Art for Fans | Ferrouswheel Bangalore
categories.description: Custom metal wall art for fans of movies, superheroes, motorsport, anime and games. Made in Bangalore and shipped across India.
intro: Tell us the movie, show, game or sport you can't stop talking about, and we'll design a piece of wall art around it.
Good for a room makeover, a gaming setup, or that friend who's watched it twelve times.

bulk.title: Bulk Custom Metal Gifts for Schools, Clubs and Companies | Ferrouswheel
bulk.description: Bulk metal gifts from Ferrouswheel in Bangalore. Medal hangers, bookmarks, keychains and mementos with your school crest or company logo. We can invoice against a PO.
